summary: Frontend-only test of the ExternalRedirect destination change from https://webmail.construpilot.pt to https://mail.ptisp.com for the 4 public routes /webmail, /mail, /roundcube, /rainloop. Used Playwright route interception to capture the actual redirect target since the sandboxed browser cannot reach mail.ptisp.com externally. All 4 routes correctly navigate to https://mail.ptisp.com/. No request goes to webmail.construpilot.pt, and no NotFound/404 page is rendered. Intermediary UI ('A redirecionar para o webmail…') is verified in source (ExternalRedirect component in /app/frontend/src/App.js:143-155) — it renders synchronously before useEffect fires window.location.replace, but the actual DOM paint is racy vs the immediate replace call, so screenshot capture ended on chrome-error page; the code, however, is correct and the text is present in the JSX.
critical_code_review_comments: ExternalRedirect uses window.location.replace inside useEffect which fires immediately after first render — the intermediary text 'A redirecionar para o webmail…' is technically painted for only a few ms before the browser leaves the page. Acceptable UX; no action needed.
The 4 routes /webmail, /mail, /roundcube, /rainloop all point to the same URL — could be DRY'd via a single array.map, but this is stylistic only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified via Playwright page.route interception that all 4 external webmail routes (/webmail, /mail, /roundcube, /rainloop) issue navigation to https://mail.ptisp.com/. No hit on webmail.construpilot.pt. Sandbox browser cannot reach mail.ptisp.com so goto ends on chrome-error://chromewebdata, which is expected and does NOT indicate a bug — it merely confirms the redirect fired to the correct external host. Internal aliases /caixa-correio, /caixa-de-correio, /mailbox still use <Navigate to='/empresa?open=mailbox' replace /> and were not affected by this change (not retested, no code change).
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a verification of a targeted fix (destination URL change) that passed.
